name: hermes_challenge_drain_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: HERMES_CHALLENGE_DRAIN_20261107 — the closed-loop Hermes challenge queue drains on the scheduled consumer (LQ-20261107-233).
The age-based drain existed but its only caller was scripts/closed_loop_reconcile.py, which no scheduler
runs; the queue reached 191 pending with an oldest age of 2 064 h while hermes_cio_worker (systemd, every
15 min) expired only challenges whose plan had completed research. These tests pin that --drain expires a
stale challenge and keeps a current one, that history is appended and never deleted, that a quiet run
reports an unchanged queue, and that a failing drain is reported in the run JSON without raising or
failing the research run. Synthetic CIO dirs under tmp_path; no network, no live store.
